CommunityApplications.Profile:
A clean, simple, and aesthetically pleasing application launcher designed for families and friends. It integrates directly with your self-hosted **Pocket ID** instance to fetch applications and handle authentication.
[b][u]Troubleshooting & Support[/u][/b]
If you encounter issues, please open a GitHub Issue at https://github.com/kc9wwh/app-launcher/issues and provide the following information: 1. [b]Unraid Version[/b] you are running. 2. A [b]screenshot[/b] of your Docker template configuration (mask any sensitive secrets/API keys). 3. [b]Container Logs[/b]: You can check the container logs in the Unraid GUI or grab the persistent JSON log if you mapped the /app/logs directory. 4. If the health status pill (Uptime Kuma integration) isn't working, please check your browser console (F12) for CORS or fetch errors.

Config.Name: Discord Webhook URL
Config.Description: The Discord Webhook URL to send support tickets to.

Config.Name: Discord User ID
Config.Description: Optional: The Discord User ID to ping when a ticket is submitted (e.g., 123456789012345678).
